[Directors’ Report]
The Public Bank Group’s wholly owned unit trust management subsidiary, Public Mutual, retained its leading market share of
43.6% in the domestic retail private unit trust industry (excluding money market funds) as at the end 2025. Public Mutual posted
profit before tax of RM850.6 million in 2025, contributing 8.9% to the Public Bank Group’s profit for 2025.

Bank Group’s net profit. The Group continued to leverage on LPI’s agency network and the Group’s broad customer base to
expand cross-selling opportunities. Meanwhile, the Group’s bancassurance business through its strategic partnership with AIA
